_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

open_questions: HELD: AU publishes no reward rate. The page says only "Earn Kiwi rewards on every UPI Scan & Pay" and "Kiwi rewards on eCom, POS & contactless transactions". The Cardmember Agreement has no Kosmo or Kiwi section. The Kiwi app terms are a partner document and were not used. No reward rule written so the importer skips it.
Network: not named on the page. UPI linking points to RuPay, but a template popup also lists Visa offers. Left null.
Fuel surcharge waiver cap: the product page and KFS say ₹100 per statement cycle; a template popup on the same page says ₹250. KFS used.
The "RuPay Offer" popup on this page names the "ABC Pro RuPay Credit Card", so it is copied template text, not Kosmo terms.
notes: Kiwi rewards are not earned on cash, rent, education & govt, insurance, EMI, fuel and BBPS transactions (page note). Not written as rules, to keep the card with no earn logic.
Rewards earned in a statement cycle are credited to the Kiwi account on statement generation and viewed in the Kiwi app (page FAQ). Apply through the Kiwi app (page FAQ).
Forex 3.49%, cash limit 20%, fuel waiver up to ₹100 per statement month on ₹400 to ₹5,000 (KFS). Add-on cards offered; Xpress EMI on ₹500+ transactions with ₹2,000 minimum total.
value.held_reason: AU publishes no Kiwi reward rate for the card.
